question.nlq: Could you show me the addresses of customers who have at least one open complaint, together with how many open complaints each has, ordered by the highest number of open complaints first?

meanings.hidden_knowledge: When I refer to 'address', I mean the primary street address – the main line where the house or building is located, not the secondary line that contains apartment or suite details.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT c.address_line_1,
       COUNT(*) AS open_complaint_count
FROM Customers c
JOIN Complaints cp ON cp.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE cp.complaint_status_code = 'Open'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.address_line_1
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
ORDER BY open_complaint_count DESC;

meanings.hidden_knowledge: When I refer to 'address', I mean the secondary line of the address – the part that holds apartment numbers, suite identifiers, or other supplemental location information.
